content:
Is stopping on a no stopping at any time an instant fail in the RTA road test?
I recently did my first RTA road test, and I failed as the examiner explained that "I was selecting the wrong gears"

Anyway, I realized after my test that I had stopped the test (To get out of the car and allow the next person to get in the drivers seat) on a place which I think had a no stopping at any time sign. Despite this, there were still many cars parked on the side of the road where I stopped the car (We were in al quoz)

Is this an instant fail (Stopping the test on a no parking sign). I would like to appeal the test as I really drove completely fine to pass, however I dont know if its worth it due to the fact that I think I stopped the test on a no stopping at any time sign. 

My intructor did not mention my parking on a no stopping sign as the reason for my fail, and the person after me stopped the car in a bus stop to change drivers and still passed.
